operative_clauses.original_operative_text: I, Franklin D. Roosevelt, President of the United States of America, do declare that a period of national emergency exists, and by virtue of said authority and of all other authority vested in me, do hereby issue the following Executive order:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 362185; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T00:27:01Z; operative words before the numbered sections

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Section 1. The Executive order of August 29, 1933, relating to the sale and export of gold recovered from natural deposits, is hereby revoked: Provided, however, That the Secretary of the Treasury is authorized to sell in accordance therewith gold received on consignment for sale on or before the date of this Executive order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 362185; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T00:27:01Z; Sec. 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 2. The United States mints and assay offices are hereby authorized, subject to such regulations as may from time to time be prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury, to receive on consignment gold which the mint or assay office to which the gold is delivered is satisfied has been recovered from natural deposits in the United States or any place subject to the jurisdiction thereof.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 362185; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T00:27:01Z; Sec. 2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 3. The Reconstruction Finance Corporation is authorized, subject to such regulations as may from time to time be prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury, to acquire gold which has been received on consignment by a United States mint or assay office, and to hold, earmark for foreign account, export, or otherwise dispose of such gold.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 362185; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T00:27:01Z; Sec. 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 4. The Executive order of August 28, 1933, relating to the hoarding, export, and earmarking of gold coin, bullion, or currency and to transactions in foreign exchange, is hereby amended to permit, subject to such regulations as may from time to time be prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury, the export of articles fabricated from gold.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 362185; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T00:27:01Z; Sec. 4

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 5. The Secretary of the Treasury is hereby authorized and empowered to issue such regulations as he may deem necessary to carry out the purposes of this Executive order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 362185; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T00:27:01Z; Sec. 5

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 6. This Executive order and any regulations issued hereunder may be modified or revoked at any time.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 362185; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T00:27:01Z; Sec. 6
